title: Distributed Training from Scratch
blurb: Implement the communication and sharding schemes behind large-scale training and check each one against single-device results.
intro: Distributed training splits the batch, the parameters or the layers across devices, and every split must reproduce single-device training. The steps compare ring all-reduce with parameter servers, simulate ring collectives, account ZeRO memory by stage, schedule a pipeline and measure its bubble, split an MLP with tensor parallelism, and take a DiLoCo outer step that communicates only every few hundred steps. The capstone implements data, tensor and ZeRO parallelism on a small MLP, checks each to round-off, and runs one DiLoCo round.
